strategy_roster.name: VWAP Bounce
strategy_roster.notes: VWAP is unavailable in the DSL, so SMA(20) proxies VWAP. Long on a bullish close below the proxy and exit on the opposite bearish signal. StopLoss=2% documented.

strategy_roster.name: ADX Donchian
strategy_roster.notes: Long side uses ADX(14)>10 and a five-bar Donchian upper breakout; prior-bar channel avoids the current-bar boundary issue. Exit below threshold-5. StopLoss=2% documented.

strategy_roster.name: Out of the Noise Intraday Strategy with VWAP
strategy_roster.notes: Session bounds and VWAP are unavailable; 20-bar Donchian bounds and an SMA(20) cross proxy the documented breakout and exits. No stop is documented.

strategy_roster.name: Lacust Stop and BE
strategy_roster.notes: Long follows the bullish last candle; a bearish candle is a signal-exit proxy. The documented fixed-price, breakeven, and trailing distances have no percentage values, so both percentage fields are null.

strategy_roster.name: Bollinger Bands Distance
strategy_roster.notes: Uses Bollinger(4,2) and the documented distance of 3 for the long threshold. Absolute price-step profit and loss exits are not expressible as percentages; mid-band reversion is the exit proxy.

strategy_roster.name: MACD EA
strategy_roster.notes: Canonical 12/26/9 MACD is used because the document lists configurable periods but gives no defaults. Opposite crossover exits; pip offsets, partial profit, breakeven, and money management are not representable here.

strategy_roster.name: Exp Spearman Rank Correlation Histogram
strategy_roster.notes: Spearman correlation and its color levels are unavailable, so a 14-bar ROC sign change proxies bullish/bearish state transitions. Trade mode and thresholds are unspecified; absolute price-unit protection is not expressible as a percentage.

strategy_roster.name: Crypto SR
strategy_roster.entry_long: sma((high + low + close) / 3,6) > sma((high + low + close) / 3,85) and roc(close,14) > 0.3 and macd(close,12,26) > macd_signal(close,12,26,9) and low <= sma((high + low + close) / 3,85) and close > open
strategy_roster.exit_long: sma((high + low + close) / 3,6) < sma((high + low + close) / 3,85) or macd(close,12,26) < macd_signal(close,12,26,9)
strategy_roster.notes: LWMA, higher-timeframe Momentum, and fractal levels are unavailable; SMA(6/85) typical price, positive ROC momentum, MACD(12,26,9), slow-average support, and bullish close proxy the long confirmation. Absolute pip protection remains null.

strategy_roster.name: DT RSI EXP1
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(rsi(close,47),50) and rsi(close,47) > 40 and rsi(close,47) < 55 and ema(close,20) < open
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(47) recross above the 50/neckline proxy, remaining above 40 and below 55 with a weak EMA filter approximates the documented long swing. Fixed price-step stops and the 4-hour EMA are unavailable, so percentage stops are null.

strategy_roster.name: TCPivot Session Stop
strategy_roster.notes: Daily pivot arithmetic and session timing are unavailable; a rolling typical-price average over 20 bars proxies the prior pivot for the long cross. Selected pivot-tier stops and optional session exit are not expressible as percentages.
